canonical_project: darya.ai - Yotta Darvoz Green AI Data Center
owner: darya.ai Ltd & Yotta Data Services (Hiranandani Group)
notes: Strategic collaboration agreement signed 25 Oct 2025 on the sidelines of AI CONF 2025 in Dushanbe between darya.ai and India's Yotta Data Services to develop a green AI data center in Darvoz district, GBAO, powered entirely by renewable hydropower and housing NVIDIA GPUs for enterprises, government and startups. Described as a new facility separate from the darya.ai H200 cluster inaugurated in June 2025; first phase of a multi-stage plan to bridge South and Central Asian AI infrastructure. No capacity or timeline disclosed (Baxtel lists it as planned, target year ~2028).
